title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Four Hundred Seven, as Amended, to Prescribe the Rules for Financing the Acquisition or Construction of Vessels to Be Used for Overseas Shipping, to Allow the Creation of a Maritime Lien Thereon, and for Other Purposes

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6106_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Six hundred six, as amended by Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred thirteen; the Code of Commerce, particularly Articles 580 and 584 thereof; and all other Acts, Executive Orders and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
